title: Starter Property Functions
description: The starter pattern for property-based tests: each property takes an agent output string and returns True or False, and one uses a regex so it matches different citation formats.

steps.description: These are the starter property functions for Exercise 1. The page says the code shows the pattern for all property functions: each one takes a string, the agent's output, and returns True or False. The comment on the first line states that pattern.

`has_citation` returns True when the output holds at least one citation or source reference. It searches with the regex `r'\[\d+\]|\(.*\d{4}\)'`, so it matches several citation formats instead of one exact string.
`is_on_topic` returns True when the output mentions at least one course-relevant keyword. It lowercases the output, then checks whether any keyword, also lowercased, appears in it.

The last lines run each property and report results. `results` maps each function's name to its result, and `pass_rate` divides the count of True results by the total. The list on the `results` line is a placeholder for your set of functions.

steps.question: The page says `has_citation` uses a regex rather than exact matching, which makes the test robust to what?
